g.text: Forward validity: independent state equations and ngspice agree

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #68737d

g.text: Voltage, current, charge and flux are compared directly over one complete 400 kHz pulse period.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Benchmark rule: all five RMS-normalized errors <1% and a complete ngspice transient. Wafer=0.019%; reflection=0.245%; all five pass.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: This establishes circuit-equation conformance, not chamber or plasma-chemistry validation.
